title: InputPoint Class
summary: Official Derivative Python API reference for InputPoint, a special Point object available in Point SOP parameters with color, normal, and optimized SOP-center access.
guidance: Use this article when generated Python is running in Point SOP parameter contexts and receives InputPoint objects rather than ordinary Point objects.
Use color and normal for Point SOP input-point convenience values; they may come from vertex data or the destination point when the input point itself lacks Cd or N.
Use sopCenter for the optimized barycentric coordinate of the SOP geometry center.
Do not use InputPoint Class as a general POP or SOP point API; it is specific to Point SOP parameter contexts.
Do not add InputPoint-only methods; the official page lists no operator specific methods and points back to Point Class for inherited point behavior.
